result.description:
SK tes is a global leader in sustainable technology lifecycle services, providing end-to-end IT asset management solutions spanning deployment, decommissioning, reuse and recycling. Operating 40+ owned facilities across more than 20 countries and supporting clients worldwide, SK tes processes and managing large-scale technology assets with a strong focus on security, compliance, and value recovery. Guided by its mission to “securely, safely, and sustainably transform and re-purpose one billion kilograms of assets by 2030,” the organisation leverages innovation and global capability to deliver meaningful outcomes for both clients and the environment.

About the Role

Company: SK tes Pty Ltd
Location: Union Cct YATALA QLD 4207
Job Type: Casual 
Salary/Rate: Award Rates Apply (Paid in accordance with the relevant Modern Award)

Role Overview

An IT Recycle Operator is responsible for the proper disposal and recycling of information technology (IT) equipment that has reached the end of its useful life. The role involves handling electronic waste (e-waste) in an environmentally responsible manner, ensuring compliance with regulations, and promoting sustainable practices. The IT Recycle Operator plays a crucial role in reducing the environmental impact of discarded IT assets and supporting the organization's commitment to responsible recycling. 

An operator will work across a multitude of departments in our production facilities. Operators will be efficient and reliable in processing, organising and packing of assets. 

Where an operator has the necessary licences, training and ability, an operator may be required to operate machinery as directed by their line manager.

Key Accountabilities

•	Be responsible for the quality assurance of their own work.
•	Works under routine supervision, either individually or in a team environment.
•	Being able to lift to 15kg.
•	Complete necessary training materials, a directed by the business.
•	Follow all reasonable directions of the Team Leader.
•	Maintain accurate records and inventory of all disposed assets.
•	Some of the daily work activities include receiving, sorting, testing, warehousing, data destruction, and de-manufacturing.
•	General tasks associated with the receiving and dispatch of assets.
•	Able to maintain records or reports in accordance with company procedures.
•	Operators will rotate and work across a multitude of departments in our production facilities and be efficient and reliable in processing, organising and packing of assets.
•	Perform data sanitization and secure data destruction processes on all retired IT assets to prevent data breaches and ensure compliance with data protection regulations.
•	Safely and responsibly handle the dismantling and disposal of electronic components following proper procedures.
•	Conduct accurate testing and assessment of returned assets to determine their potential for refurbishment or reuse as per the guidelines.
•	Conduct Inventory Stock Take activities.
•	May be directed to perform other duties consistent with training and skill levels required for this position.
•	Maintaining confidentiality and ensuring data security throughout the ITAD process.

Job Requirements & Qualifications

•	Experience in Warehousing (Preferable) 
•	A valid forklift licence is a PLUS but not required
•	Effective communication skills
•	Basic admin/data entry capability
•	Understanding of IT hardware components and familiarity with various types of electronic devices.
•	Physical fitness to handle and move electronic equipment.
•	Ability to operate recycling machinery and equipment safely and efficiently.
•	Strong attention to detail to ensure proper sorting and disposal of e-waste.

What We Offer

•	Competitive remuneration package
•	Career progression opportunities
•	Ongoing training and professional development
•	Supportive and collaborative team environment
•	Opportunity to be part of a growing global organisation focused on sustainability and innovation

result.description:
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Web Administrator to join our team and take ownership of our web presence, infrastructure, and digital platforms. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining websites while delivering reliable web technology solutions that support the organisation's objectives. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure our web environments are secure, performant, and continuously optimised. The ideal candidate brings a strong technical foundation, a proactive mindset, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
## Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain websites and web applications, ensuring consistent functionality, visual integrity, and a positive user experience across all platforms
- Monitor and manage web server performance, uptime, and availability, responding promptly to incidents and implementing preventative measures to minimise disruption
- Administer and configure web hosting environments, domains, DNS settings, and SSL certificates to ensure secure and reliable operation
- Collaborate with content, marketing, and development teams to publish, update, and manage web content in accordance with brand guidelines and accessibility standards
- Implement and maintain web security protocols, including regular vulnerability assessments, software patching, and user access controls to safeguard digital assets
- Analyse web traffic data and performance metrics using analytics tools, providing actionable insights and recommendations to improve engagement and site effectiveness
- Manage and maintain content management systems (CMS), including configuration, plugin or module updates, and user permission management
- Develop and enforce web standards, coding best practices, and documentation to ensure consistency and maintainability across all web properties
- Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to websites, web applications, and integrations in a timely and effective manner
- Support the planning and execution of website migrations, upgrades, and redesign projects, coordinating with internal stakeholders and third-party vendors as required
- Conduct regular audits of website content, links, and functionality to identify and rectify errors, broken pages, or outdated information
- Provide technical guidance and support to internal users on web-related tools, platforms, and best practices
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Web Development, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience
- Proven experience in a web administration, web development, or similar technical role
- Proficiency in core web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
- Hands-on experience administering web servers such as Apache or Nginx, and working within Linux or Windows server environments
- Solid understanding of DNS management, domain administration, SSL/TLS certificates, and web hosting infrastructure
- Experience managing content management systems such as WordPress, Drupal, or similar platforms
- Familiarity with web analytics tools such as Google Analytics or similar, with the ability to interpret data and report findings clearly
- Working knowledge of web security best practices, including vulnerability management and access control
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues efficiently
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to liaise effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Highly organised with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver outcomes within agreed timeframes
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as Google Analytics, AWS, Microsoft Azure, or CompTIA Security+
- Experience with version control systems such as Git and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or deployment workflows
- Knowledge of PHP, Python, or other server-side scripting languages
- Experience with SEO best practices and web accessibility standards such as WCAG 2.1

result.description:
Full job description 

We are seeking a highly skilled Solution Architect with proven expertise in Ezy-Serve, Change-Ezy SaaS and SAP solutions. The ideal candidate must have led end-to-end implementation of Ezy-Serve SaaS solution with integration to SAP S/4 HANA. Web Application, mobile application development, architecture, and deployment in Field Service Mobility Solutions. This role requires extensive customer engagement, technical solutioning, and ongoing support to ensure seamless adoption and optimization of the SaaS platform. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Architect, develop, and optimize the Ezy-Serve, Service Delivery platform and Ezy-Day mobile applications for iOS and Android. 

Own the full software lifecycle from conceptualization to go-live for Ezy-Serve mobility solutions. 

Drive the next-gen evolution of Ezy-Serve and Ezy-Day, enhancing performance, security, and scalability. 

Ensure seamless backend integration of Ezy-Day and the Ezy-Serve platform using RESTful services with SAP S/4 HANA, SAP GEF and integration with ESRI ArcGIS. 

Provide technical leadership to a team of developers, mentoring them on mobile app best practices. 

Drive implementation of SAP GEF on S/4 HANA integration with ESRI ArcGIS. 

Develop offline-capable mobile applications with advanced GIS integrations, including ESRI, SAP GEF, Mapbox, and OpenStreetMap. 

Act as a primary liaison for enterprise customers, ensuring successful implementation, troubleshooting, and support. 

Conduct customer engagement workshops to gather requirements, provide demonstrations, and ensure seamless onboarding of SaaS solutions. 

Collaborate with customer IT teams to align Ezy-Serve SaaS solutions with existing enterprise applications. 

Monitor and support customer deployments, ensuring high availability, proactive issue resolution, and continual improvements. 

Spearhead mobile app security using authentication, encryption, and data protection best practices. 

Manage the scalability and performance optimization of Ezy-Serve and mobility solutions for large enterprise customers. 

 

 

Mandatory Requirements: 

Hands-on experience in Ezy-Serve and Change-Ezy SaaS products, with multiple deployments. 

Proficiency in Android (Java), iOS (Swift), Angular WebApplication, and Restful Integration for enterprise field mobility applications. 

Strong experience in GIS mapping solutions within Ezy-Serve, S/4 HANA, Ezy-Day and ESRI ArcGIS. 

Expertise in Spring Boot, REST APIs, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and microservices architecture. 

Experience in customer support, implementation, and SaaS product maintenance. 

Proven track record of integrating mobile apps with ERP and enterprise systems. 

Experience leading cross-functional teams, including backend, frontend, and cloud engineers. 

Excellent customer relationship management and communication skills. 

Experience in IoT-driven FSM applications. 

Hands-on experience with SAP integrations for Ezy-Serve solutions. 

Strong knowledge of serverless architectures, AWS, and cloud-native technologies. 

Must have hands on experience in Ezy -Serve solutions and high-traffic FSM solutions with thousands of active users. 

This role is open only to candidates with experience working on Ezy-Serve. Candidates with experience in Ezy-Serve or Change-Ezy solutions are needed. 

Job Type: Full-time 

Pay: $75,000.00 – $90,000.00 per year 

Education: 

Bachelor Degree (mandatory) 

Experience: 

IT: 9+ years (Required) 

SAP integrations for Ezy-Serve solutions: 7+ years (Required)
